notices.title: Admissions Open for Academic Session 2025-26
notices.summary: Registration open from Nursery to Class IX & XI. Prospectus and application forms available at school reception and online.
notices.content: New Global Wisdom International School announces admissions for the academic year 2025-26. Parents are requested to fill the admission enquiry form online or visit the school office between 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM on working days.

notices.title: Annual Sports Meet 'Urja 2025' Announcement
notices.summary: Inter-house sports competitions scheduled from February 15-17, 2025. Track and field events for all age categories.
notices.content: All students from Classes 3 to 12 are invited to register for athletics, football, cricket, and indoor games with their respective house captains.

notices.title: Holiday Notification: Maha Shivratri
notices.summary: School will remain closed on the auspicious occasion of Maha Shivratri. Regular classes will resume next working day.
notices.content: All academic and administrative offices will observe a holiday. Normal school timings will apply from the following morning.

events.title: Annual Cultural Festival - 'Pratibha'
events.description: Celebrating student talents across traditional Indian dance, musical orchestrations, theatrical performances, and art showcases.

events.title: Science & Innovation Fair 2025
events.description: Hands-on robotics exhibits, environmental conservation models, and working scientific prototypes by middle and senior school scholars.
